design.seed_aggregation: average all nuisance-factor cells within each source-training seed before paired inference
design.multiplicity: Holm correction separately across all 35 planned contrasts for each endpoint
design.uncertainty: 95% percentile bootstrap over five source-training seed means
design.p_value: exact two-sided sign-flip over five paired seed differences; minimum attainable nonzero p is 0.0625
design.confirmatory_boundary: CIFAR-10, noise severity 1, frozen-BN-affine policy, independently reimplemented methods

claim_boundary.supported: the factorial campaign estimates how trajectory order, recurrence, pass count, and learning rate change return behavior under the registered CIFAR-10 protocol
claim_boundary.not_supported: generalization to standard CIFAR-C corruptions, CIFAR-100-C, natural shifts, or a universal mechanism
claim_boundary.inference_limit: with five independent source-training seeds, exact two-sided sign-flip tests cannot attain p < 0.05; effect sizes and uncertainty intervals carry the interpretation
